citation.authors: Velloso EDRP, Dos Santos AO, Dinardo CL et al

cited_by.title: Low haemoglobin, low or high white cells: causes, thresholds and pregnancy

record.population: 311 healthy adult blood donors at two Brazilian blood banks; 46.6% self-identified as Black or mixed-race; 146 (46.9%) Duffy-null
record.design: Prospective reference-interval study with Duffy phenotyping
record.finding: Duffy-null donors had a median neutrophil count of 2,250 against 4,070 per microlitre; the 95% reference range was 1,180 to 4,800 against 2,200 to 7,250. They also had higher red cell counts, haemoglobin, haematocrit and platelet counts. The authors support Duffy-specific intervals.
record.note: Participants grouped by Duffy status. Blood donors are healthier than average.
